applies_why: The judge text labels a verse-level dispute UNDERDETERMINED by pointing to two different answers about Matthew 1:20, which is what K-S2 governs.
quote: D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: "A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand": one reading allows UNDERDETERMINED when the two sides assign different senses; the other forbids treating such a verse as open and requires both senses to stand.
why: The judge declares Matthew 1:20 UNDERDETERMINED because the challenger gives it a covenant-presence sense and the defender a physical-source sense, treating the two-sense verse as open despite K-S2.
